newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P lowers ANI rating to BBB-minus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P lowers ANI rating to BBB-minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said it had cut Australian National Industries Ltd's (ANI) rating to BBB-minus.
S&P said the cut in the long term credit rating from BBB saw it removed from creditwatch where it was placed on September 3.
The ratings agency said the downgrade reflected the company's weakened margins and its heightened business risk profile.

S&P said cash flow margins in the company's core manufacturing business had been negatively impacted by increased competition while the Holter environmental engineering business suffered from cost overruns and technical difficulties.
The short-term credit rating of A-3 was affirmed.
S&P said the ratings outlook was stable.
"The rating expects ANI to restore operations to levels appropriate for a low investment-grade rating," S&P said.
"The company's leading market position, coupled with improving operating efficiencies, should support current credit quality," it said.
